{{Quote|My parents told me stories of the Jedi when I was a boy. Now I know they're true.|Yelzrin|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Yelzrin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] colonist who led a [[Lake Brell colony|settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] [[Rora Seake]] was sent to wipe out the colony. Fortunately for Yelzrin and the other colonists, a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] learned of Seake's mission and intercepted the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] before she could [[Death/Legends|kill]] the colonists, [[Duel in the Lake Brell colony bunker|defeating]] the assassin and saving the settlers' lives.

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is horrible. We're not prepared for this.''"<br />"''Then you should not have come back to a world that is not yours.|Yelzrin and Rora Seake|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Yelzrin was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and [[Yelzrin's father|Yelzrin's]] [[Yelzrin's mother|parents]] told him stories of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as he grew up, though he always had some doubt about their veracity.<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he was among those [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] and settlers who were selected by the Republic to resettle the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as part of their [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|reclamation effort]], and Yelzrin was chosen as the leader of a group of settlers. His group established a [[Lake Brell colony|colony]] on the shores of [[Lake Brell]], in an old bunker built into the hills. However, his colony was targeted by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire in its efforts to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the Republic's resettlement of Taris; the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] [[Rora Seake]] was sent to wipe out the colony.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Seake_and_pets.png|thumb|left|250px|Rora Seake and her jurgoran pets]]
{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Fortunately for the colonists, an [[Watcher One|Imperial operative]] leaked Seake's mission to a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]], and the Jedi and a companion reached the settlement before Seake. Yelzrin greeted the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and offered his visitors whatever they wanted from their supplies, but he was confused when the Knight warned him of Seake's impending arrival. Shocked, Yelzrin started to gather the other colonists for evacuation, but it was too late&mdash;Seake arrived with two massive creatures known as [[jurgoran]]s, which she kept as pets. As Yelzrin fell to his knees in terror, the Jedi intercepted Seake and confronted the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Duel in the Lake Brell colony bunker|defeating]] Seake's pets and then the assassin herself. Immensely relieved, Yelzrin offered whatever reward he could provide to his saviors, but the Knight refused to accept it. With the Jedi's departure, Yelzrin and his colonists set about building up their settlement's defenses against further incursions.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Welcome, Master Jedi. How did our humble settlement earn this honor? Do you need food or water? Anything we have is yours.|Yelzrin|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Yelzrin was dark-skinned with short [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He admired the Jedi, as he was told stories about them as a child, though he never truly believed them until he met a Jedi in person on Taris. Yelzrin was generous despite his settlement's relative newness; even before the Jedi saved the colony, he was willing to share his settlement's limited supplies with the visiting Jedi.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
Yelzrin wore blue and brown armored clothes while living on Taris.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yelzrin appears in the Jedi Knight-class mission "A More Immediate Concern" in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The mission is only received if the player has a positive [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment at the end of the previous mission; [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] players are instead sent to acquire stolen Jedi relics from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Players can also refuse the mission to help the colonists, which rewards the player with dark side alignment points. As the Jedi Knight is a Republic class and is thus assumed to make decisions that reward in the maximum light side points, this article assumes the player saved Yelzrin and the colonists.<ref name="TOR" />
